name: The Standing Ash
line: A tree that was a soldier, and is still standing to attention.
detail: Does not move. Any Art fired within 160 px wakes it. Awake, it walks at 60 px/s with its arms out.
silhouette: Tall, narrow, one branch that is an arm. 96 x 96. Passes at 32 px black-fill.
death: Collapses inward, vertically, into a heap of grey lines. No fire.

name: The Slow Ascender
line: A figure climbing the stair that never arrives.
detail: Moves upward on the screen at 30 px/s and cannot be pushed down. If it reaches the top edge it becomes a mini-boss with 8x HP and does not despawn.
silhouette: Climbing posture, one hand above the head. 96 x 96. Never drawn with a face.
death: It lets go. Falls the whole way down, and does not splash.

name: The Reciting Choir
line: Five salt figures who must be killed in a specific order.
detail: Five bodies, one shared health bar. Killing them out of the displayed order resummons all five at full health. The order is shown as a small mark on each body's chest.
silhouette: Identical bodies, differentiated only by the chest notch count. 96 x 96. Documented exception to the silhouette gate: this one is read by marking, not outline.
death: Each one cracks and pours; the last one falls silently.

name: The Reflection That Stays
line: It copies your last three seconds of movement and then it does not stop.
detail: Mimics the player's movement path on a 3-second delay, then continues past the end of that path on its own. Grows 1% in size per second it survives.
silhouette: The player's own base rig, palette-shifted to VENOM shadow, no core light.
death: Shatters, and each shard teleports 40 px outward before fading.

name: The Grafter
line: It takes a cutting from you and grows it.
detail: On a successful hit it copies one of the player's equipped Arts and grows a hostile copy of it. The copy fires every 4 seconds at 50% power. Killing the Grafter destroys all grown copies.
silhouette: Tall, thin, one held blade for cutting, one hand permanently cupped for holding a cutting. 96 x 96.
death: Every copy it grew wilts and drops simultaneously.

name: The Lamplighter
line: It does not attack you. It attacks the field.
detail: It walks to unlit lanterns and lights them. Each lit lantern spawns a swarm of 4. Killing it early is the entire skill check.
silhouette: Tall, stooped, carrying a light on a stick held behind it. 96 x 96. The light must be the brightest point on the sprite.
death: Its own lantern goes out first, then it falls.
